links.outcome: LLM LOINC mapping accuracy against expert consensus reference standard
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 highest complete match in clinical chemistry (58.2%); Perplexity best in hematology (55.0%); Gemini highest mismatch, hematology 80.0%.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 achieved the highest CM rate in clinical chemistry (58.2%), whereas Perplexity AI performed best in hematology (55.0%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy of three LLMs (ChatGPT-4.0, Gemini 1.5, and Perplexity AI) for mapping laboratory test items to LOINC codes compared to an expert consensus gold standard.
